## GSD Executor Rule

When a plan needs to be implemented (PLAN.md, phase plans, GSD phases):

**DO NOT execute plans directly in this session.** Spawn the `gsd-executor` agent:

```
Agent(description: "execute-phase-X-Y", prompt: "Execute the plan ...", subagent_type: "gsd-executor")
```

Always use `subagent_type: "gsd-executor"`. Do not implement GSD plans inline.
